diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong upward trend (a net rise of ~22% of its level). Seasonality is strong (period 52): a repeating cycle explains much of the movement. Predictability is middling — structured signal and irregular noise are balanced. The series reads as ambiguous by the ADF/KPSS tests. A few outliers stand out (2 points, ~2% of the sample). Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau -0.053), which favours a robust combination.

decision.justification: Selected 'dba' (an agent proposal) as the best of 11 backtested attempts, score 0.9518. Series context: trend strength 0.9999 and seasonal strength 1.0; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.053); 4 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 1.286.
